odysseyAct2HeroCloudsMsLaneB.note: RETIRED 2026-08-14: the hero cumulus were removed from the default path by the owner - an art-direction call (two cloud MODELS in one sky do not cohere; the smooth lobed masses read as a different object class beside the deck's flat painted bands), NOT a perf call. Retired per the ADR-0015 pattern (module/tests/lever retained). Polarity flipped: heroes are now opt-in (?odysseyWorldHeroes=1; gpu-split configuration `heroes`, whose heroesMs is the heroes configuration minus baseline - argument order carries the sign, never negate it), so the numbers below describe a system the shipped frame no longer contains. They are kept because two findings are transferable and were paid for: (1) opaque merged geometry rasterises only its own silhouette, emits no blend state, and cost 1-2 timer ticks for six authored masses - the standing refutation of billboard imposters on this fill-bound lane; (2) the heroes earned NO occlusion credit against the deck (from a camera below an overhead sheet, everything above it is behind it along the ray) - purely additive. ORIGINAL NOTE (2026-08-13, measured under the old heroes-on baseline): THE HERO CUMULUS (cloud plan §7.1), via the `no-heroes` gpu-split lever. Tracked, not gated — a differential, not a frame budget. MEASURED 2026-08-13, both pairs draws content-matched with the mesh accounting for EXACTLY +1 draw as designed: ch4 p=0.42 -> 0.066 ms (baseline 10.62/10.62, drift EXACTLY 0.000, 49 vs 48 draws); ch5 p=0.569 -> 0.131 ms (baseline 9.83/9.76, drift 0.066, 54 vs 53 draws). ONE AND TWO TIMER TICKS — i.e. at or barely above the 65.536us resolution floor, for six authored cloud masses. This is the vindication of choosing OPAQUE GEOMETRY over billboards: the mesh rasterises only its own silhouette (a quad rasterises its bounding rect), FrontSide culls the far half of every closed lobe, the fragment shader does ZERO texture fetches, and an opaque NormalBlending material emits no blend state at all so the frame pays no read-modify-write. Contrast the deck, whose 1.376 ms is coverage-INDEPENDENT because every rasterised sheet fragment runs the full tap stack. NOTE the heroes earn NO occlusion credit against the deck (from a camera below an overhead sheet, everything above it is behind it along the ray) — they are purely additive, and additive here is one tick. Reports: gpu-split-laneb-heroes-{ch4-p042,ch5-p0569}.json.

odysseyAct2CloudDeckMsLaneB.note: RETIRED 2026-08-14 by the owner: the flat cloud SHEET was replaced as Act II's sky by the sculpted cloud field (see odysseyAct2CloudFieldMsLaneB). Restorable with ?odysseyWorldCloudSheet=1; the gpu-split lever flipped from `no-clouds` to `cloud-sheet`, so cloudsMs is now the cost of ADDING it back. MEASURED AT THE SWAP, ch5 p=0.569, drift -0.066, draws content-matched: adding the sheet back on top of the shipped field costs 2.032 ms, against the field's own 0.197 ms. That is the marginal price of each, measured in one run; see odysseyAct2Ch5SkyGpuP50LaneBMs for why the swap's own saving is an ESTIMATE (~1.835 ms) and not a measurement. ⚠️ THE LAW THIS CELL EXISTS TO PRESERVE, still true and still the reason the sheet lost: its cost is COVERAGE-INDEPENDENT. Every rasterised fragment of a full-screen transparent sheet runs the whole tap stack whether or not it lands on cloud, and discard only saves the blend write - proven when cutting coverage 0.63/0.40 -> 0.685/0.515 moved cloudsMs by EXACTLY ZERO. That is why 'reduce coverage to save fill' is dead for any system of this shape, and why opaque geometry that rasterises only its own silhouette wins on this fill-bound lane. ORIGINAL NOTE (2026-08-13, measured while it still shipped): THE DECK'S PRICE, and the resolution of the cloud plan's Wave 2 exit gate. Tracked, not gated - a differential, not a frame budget (ADR-0016: an unmeasured cost cannot fund a package). ALL FIGURES Lane B, Radeon 610M (amd/rdna-2), 1280x720, Medium, --chapters 3,4,5, --only baseline,no-clouds,baseline-repeat, draws content-matched min==max in every window. LEDGER at ch4 p=0.42: Wave 0 incumbent 1.049 (drift 0.000) -> Waves 1a/1b/2 1.376 (drift 0.066, +0.327, FAILED the +0.15 gate) -> +regime gate 1.311 (drift 0.328, inconclusive) -> 2026-08-13 FINAL 1.180 (drift -0.066). Net vs the incumbent +0.131 ms against a +0.15 gate: PASSES, though the effect is only 2x the drift bound, so the honest band is roughly +0.065..+0.197 and the upper end grazes the gate. At ch5 p=0.569: Wave 0 1.901 (drift 0.000) -> FINAL 1.835 (drift -0.066), i.e. PARITY - the change equals one 65.536us timer tick and nothing is claimed either way. THE RECOVERY from 1.376 to 1.180 is attributed to the `uCloudTopLit` regime gate, the plan's FIRST ordered reserve lever, but this is inference across sessions, not a measured attribution: the sessions differ thermally (both frame baselines sit ~0.3-0.46 ms above the post-reboot Wave 0 session). CAVEAT UNCHANGED: the deck mesh is still constructed and only withheld from the group, so this is DRAWS + FILL + VERTEX with pipeline-compile on both sides - a floor, not a ceiling. STANDING LAW from this cell's own history: the deck's cost is COVERAGE-INDEPENDENT (0.63/0.40 -> 0.685/0.515 moved it by exactly zero), so the whole 'reduce coverage to save fill' family of fixes is dead here. Reports: gpu-split-laneb-clouds-{ch4-p042,ch5-p0569}{,-sqrt}.json.
